additionalFaq: How should I size a pastry box for a mixed bakery order?

Arrange the actual assortment with its liners, cups and dividers first. Measure the occupied footprint and tallest decorated item, then check lid clearance and the side-flap folding area on a sample. A menu portion count alone does not specify a usable box size.
When should I compare a folding pastry carton with a window cake box?

Compare this flat-folding hinged carton for a bakery assortment assembled at the counter. Compare a window cake box with removable base when visibility and lifting out one decorated cake are central to the brief. The final structure, direct-contact layer, assembly time and finished dimensions must be confirmed separately.
What information is needed to compare pizza box board and ventilation?

Send the finished pizza diameter and height, typical packed weight, number stacked, food condition at packing and expected delivery journey. Ask for a sample of the complete proposed board and liner construction. Check condensation, base condition and closure after your actual service trial instead of selecting a flute from a photograph.
Does a printed pizza box replace an insulated delivery bag?

No insulation or holding-time rating is published for this format. Review the carton together with your packing workflow and delivery equipment. A packaging quotation does not establish food holding time, microwave compatibility or a food-safety process.
How is a collapsible magnetic gift box different from a corrugated mailer?

This format assembles into a rigid presentation box with a magnetic closure. A corrugated mailer uses a different folded board construction and closure. Specify gift presentation and transit protection separately; neither the magnetic closure nor a product photograph establishes shipping protection.
What should a magnetic gift-box prototype demonstrate?

Use the complete gift set and proposed insert to review internal fit, corner assembly, lid alignment and repeated opening. Agree the delivery configuration, packed quantity and protective shipping outer. Confirm wrap, finish, insert material and artwork versions in the same specification before comparing prices.
Must every advent-calendar drawer have the same internal size?

Do not assume equal drawers or a fixed drawer count from the illustrative image. List each gift, its dimensions, weight and removal clearance. Use that item schedule to review the drawer layout, cabinet dimensions and structural prototype. Feasibility, minimum quantity and sampling are confirmed for the proposed construction.
What should I confirm before ordering a custom advent-calendar cabinet?

Confirm the contents schedule, drawer extraction, door clearance, insert fit, artwork numbering and protection of the loaded cabinet. Work backwards from the required arrival date to sample approval, production and delivery, with each timing confirmed in the quotation. No Christmas arrival deadline or production lead time is guaranteed on this page.

custom-burger-clamshell-box.seoTitle: Printed Burger Clamshell Box | Custom Fit | MXPACKPRO
custom-burger-clamshell-box.seoDescription: Compare hinged burger boxes by finished burger fit, lid clearance and custom artwork. Send your size, quantity and delivery country for a project quotation.
custom-burger-clamshell-box.intro: This printed burger clamshell is a hinged carton with a tuck closure, specified around one finished burger and its wrapping. Compare the internal footprint, topping clearance and artwork layout on this construction; a bun diameter alone is not a box specification.
custom-burger-clamshell-box.quoteBrief: For a burger-box quotation, send the finished burger diameter and height, wrapping dimensions, quantity per size or artwork, and delivery country. Add a photo of the assembled order and explain whether fries travel separately. Ask us to confirm internal dimensions, closure and sample scope in the same quotation.

exportBrief.title: Confirm the burger-box pack-out.
exportBrief.intro: For a North American or Middle Eastern restaurant enquiry, compare the complete delivered scope as well as the printed carton. Use one approved size and artwork breakdown throughout the brief.
checks: Label the internal length, width and closed height in millimetres or inches. If you supply both units, identify the primary measurement and the conversion. Approve the matching dieline and packed-burger sample rather than assuming a regional standard size.

List pieces for each box size and artwork version. Confirm how the cartons are supplied for assembly, pieces per export carton and the proposed outer-carton dimensions and weight. Do not infer a shipping configuration from an assembled product photo.

Give the destination country, city and postcode where used, plus the required arrival date. Ask which freight, clearance and destination charges are included, and request separate sample, production and transit estimates. The written quotation confirms the scope; no delivery date or market approval is implied.

selectionGuide.title: Build your burger-box specification.
selectionGuide.intro: Start with the order as the customer receives it. Use the same packed burger to compare proposed box dimensions and a structural sample.
rows: Footprint
Measure the finished burger at its widest point, including any wrap that remains inside the carton. Request internal, not just external, box dimensions.
Lid clearance
Include toppings and the highest point of the bun. Check that the proposed closed lid does not press the food during your packing trial.
Order format
Identify whether this carton holds one burger or needs to form part of a larger meal order. Compare a separate meal carton when fries or drinks need their own positions.
Artwork versions
State the pieces required for each size and design. Review artwork against the agreed dieline rather than transferring it from a differently sized lid.

additionalFaq: Can one clamshell size cover burgers with different topping heights?

Provide the smallest and largest finished burgers, with their normal wrapping. Review clearance and movement on a structural sample for both orders. A single size may be worth comparing, but fit is not established by bun diameter or a picture of the box.
Should a burger clamshell hold the fries as well?

Specify the complete meal layout before requesting a price. This page concerns the hinged burger carton; a meal carton or separate fries pack is a different layout. Confirm which components are included and test the assembled order before approving dimensions.

corn-dog-paper-sleeve.seoTitle: Custom Corn Dog Sleeves | Size & Print | MXPACKPRO
corn-dog-paper-sleeve.seoDescription: Plan custom corn dog paper sleeves around coated snack diameter, covered length and stick clearance. Compare size, artwork and sample checks for your order.
corn-dog-paper-sleeve.intro: Custom corn dog paper sleeves are open-ended snack packs sized around the finished coating and stick. Measure the thickest coated section and the length you want covered, then review the opening, grip area and printed layout on a sample of the packed snack.
corn-dog-paper-sleeve.quoteBrief: Send the finished coated diameter, snack length, exposed stick length and desired sleeve coverage. Include the recipe and packing temperature for a material review, the quantity per design, delivery country and artwork status. Confirm the agreed opening and sample route before comparing quotations.

exportBrief.title: Approve the serving and export pack together.
exportBrief.intro: For a North American or Middle Eastern enquiry, identify the exact destination and the serving you want packed. Sleeve fit, printed quantity and export packing are separate parts of a comparable quotation.
checks: Put millimetres or inches beside the finished opening and covered-length measurements. Check the thickest coated serving on the prototype, including toppings that enter the sleeve. State which dimension is primary if you send a converted second unit.

Request quantities per printed design and confirm sleeves per bundle, whether they are supplied flat or formed, and the proposed export-carton count, dimensions and weight. These details require quotation confirmation; the reference image is not a stock packing specification.

Send country, city and postcode where used, required arrival date, food recipe and packing/contact conditions. Identify the material documentation your buyer needs for that destination. Ask the quotation to separate sample, sleeve and transport scope rather than treating a general food-safe claim as evidence for every market.

selectionGuide.title: Measure the snack, not only the stick.
selectionGuide.intro: Use a finished item from the menu for the size brief. Different coatings and toppings can change the space needed at the sleeve opening.
rows: Opening
Measure the thickest part of the coating, including any topping that enters the sleeve. Confirm the finished opening on the proposed construction.
Covered length
Mark where the packaging should end on the snack and how much stick should remain exposed for serving. Do not substitute the overall stick length for the covered food length.
Packing conditions
Describe the food condition at packing, expected contact time and grease exposure. Material and any barrier require review for this specific use.
Print position
Show the intended front, opening and hand-grip area on the dieline. Confirm that key artwork remains visible after the sleeve is filled.

additionalFaq: Can one sleeve fit both plain and heavily topped corn dogs?

Do not assume so. Measure the widest finished coating and any topping that enters the sleeve, along with the covered length and exposed stick. Compare the smallest and largest servings on the proposed sample. Keep an alternative size in the quotation if the same opening does not fit both without forcing the food.
Is an open corn dog sleeve the same as a closed takeaway box?

No. This format leaves part of the serving open and is specified around snack presentation and handling. If the order needs a closed outer pack, describe that requirement separately; a sleeve image does not establish delivery protection or holding time.

custom-food-wrapping-paper.seoTitle: Custom Printed Food Wrapping Paper | Sheets | MXPACKPRO
custom-food-wrapping-paper.seoDescription: Specify printed food wrapping paper sheets by wrap overlap, tray fit, artwork repeat and intended use. Prepare dimensions and quantities for a custom quotation.
custom-food-wrapping-paper.intro: Custom printed food wrapping paper is supplied to a project brief for loose wrapping sheets or tray liners. Choose the sheet dimensions around the finished wrap or tray, then review print layout and the proposed paper, ink and coating for the intended food-contact conditions.
custom-food-wrapping-paper.quoteBrief: For cut-sheet pricing, send the finished sheet width and length, whether it wraps food or lines a tray, quantity per artwork and packing quantity requirements. Include food type, contact time, packing temperature and delivery market for a material review. A reference print does not confirm the final contact specification.

selectionGuide.title: Choose the sheet around the packing task.
selectionGuide.intro: A wrapping sheet and a tray liner can use the same artwork but need different finished dimensions. State the task before requesting a unit price.
rows: Food wrap
Measure the finished food and the overlap needed for the intended folds. Share a photo or mock-up of the wrapped order, not only the unwrapped food dimensions.
Tray liner
Provide the tray's internal base dimensions and the required side coverage. Check how the cut sheet sits in the actual tray.
Artwork repeat
Provide the logo file, print colors and preferred repeat direction. Review how the design lands at the sheet edges and folds on a size-specific proof.
Menu and market
Identify each intended food use and destination market. Do not assume one paper or coating specification covers every recipe and contact condition.

additionalFaq: Is this quotation for wrapping sheets or paper rolls?

This page describes loose cut sheets for wrapping or tray lining. Send the required finished sheet dimensions and packing quantity. A roll format, dispenser arrangement or another delivery format needs a separate project review rather than an assumption from the sheet photograph.
Can one printed sheet specification cover burgers and bakery products?

Artwork can be discussed as a coordinated design, but the proposed paper, ink and any coating must be reviewed for each intended use. Describe the food, packing temperature, contact time and destination market. Do not treat matching print as evidence of matching food-contact suitability.

custom-strap-catering-tray-carrier.seoTitle: Catering Tray Carriers with Straps | Custom | MXPACKPRO
custom-strap-catering-tray-carrier.seoDescription: Compare catering tray carriers with straps by lidded-container fit, filled mass and handoff layout. Prepare a custom carrier brief and loaded-sample checks.
custom-strap-catering-tray-carrier.intro: A catering tray carrier with a carry strap groups specified containers on an open tray platform. Start with the actual lidded containers and complete filled mass, then review tray positions, strap attachment and the intended handoff on a loaded sample; no carrying-weight rating is inferred from the picture.
custom-strap-catering-tray-carrier.quoteBrief: Send the outside dimensions of every container with its lid, a layout photo, total filled mass and how the order will be lifted and handed over. State whether you need the carrier alone or a coordinated container supply, quantity per design and destination. Confirm strap, reinforcement and sample scope as separate quotation items.

selectionGuide.title: Specify the complete filled tray.
selectionGuide.intro: Container capacity alone does not describe the space or handling needed by a catering carrier. Compare the actual lids, layout and lifting method together.
rows: Container fit
List outside length, width and height with lids fitted. Identify which items need positions, cutouts or other project-specific support.
Strap arrangement
Provide the complete filled mass and intended grip position. Review the proposed attachment and reinforcement with a loaded sample, without assuming a published weight limit.
Handoff workflow
Explain where the pack is lifted, carried and set down, and how containers are removed. Check balance and access during your actual handling trial.
Supply scope
Ask the quotation to identify carrier, strap, inserts and containers separately. Food and containers shown in an example image are not evidence of included supply.

additionalFaq: Are the containers included with the catering tray carrier?

Do not infer included supply from the picture. State whether you need the carrier only, existing containers fitted to it or a coordinated container proposal. Confirm every component and quantity in the written quotation.
When should I compare a strap tray with an enclosed catering carrier box?

Compare this open platform when grouped container access and the strap arrangement suit the intended handoff. Compare an enclosed multi-tray carton when an outer enclosure is part of the brief. Review container fit, filled mass and handling on the proposed sample; neither format is assigned a transit or carrying rating by its photograph.

custom-folding-cosmetic-carton.seoTitle: Custom Cosmetic Folding Cartons | Printed | MXPACKPRO
custom-folding-cosmetic-carton.seoDescription: Specify printed cosmetic folding cartons for skincare bottles by capped size, insert fit and artwork panels. Prepare a size-specific sample and quotation brief.
custom-folding-cosmetic-carton.intro: Custom cosmetic folding cartons are printed paperboard outer packs for individual skincare bottles and small cosmetic containers. Specify the complete capped container, opening direction and artwork panels before choosing a board or finish. This page covers the folding retail carton, not the bottle, a rigid presentation set or a shipping mailer.
custom-folding-cosmetic-carton.quoteBrief: Send a drawing or measured sample of the capped bottle, including the pump or dropper, the required quantity per size and artwork, and the delivery country. Identify any insert, label or barcode panels and the requested print finish. Ask the quotation to separate the structural sample, printed proof, carton and insert scope. Confirm schedule after the dieline and artwork review; no stock size or production deadline is assumed.

selectionGuide.title: Prepare a cosmetic-carton print brief.
selectionGuide.intro: The bottle size, carton opening and artwork must describe the same proposed pack. Use a structural sample for fit and a size-specific proof for the printed panels.
rows: Primary container
Measure the bottle or jar with the actual cap, pump or dropper fitted. Include any label projection and explain how the container is inserted and removed.
Closure and insert
Confirm the proposed opening direction, tuck flaps and any internal support on the dieline. Check that the insert does not obstruct closure or cover the product label.
Print and finish

Provide vector artwork, color references and finish locations. Review small text, fold lines and the barcode area on the proposed board and size-specific proof; a reference photo is not a print approval.
Order breakdown
List the pieces for every carton size and artwork version, plus destination and target date. Confirm the applicable MOQ, sample route and packing configuration in the written quotation.

additionalFaq: What should I prepare before asking a cosmetic folding-carton printer for a quote?

Provide the complete capped-container dimensions or a sample, quantities per size and design, intended opening, insert requirements and delivery country. Add artwork files, color references and the desired finish areas. A general size or the word luxury alone does not define the board, construction or print scope.
Does a structural sample also approve the printed finish?

A structural sample is used to review fit, insertion, removal and closure. Confirm separately what the printed proof or production sample represents for color, finish and text. Approve the agreed dieline and artwork version before production; the available sample process, charges and timing are confirmed for the project.
